packages.name: Lab Website + Auto Publications
packages.problem: Your research needs a clear public home, and your publications page needs to stay current.
deliverables: A responsive lab or project website with people, research, publications, and contact pages.
A configurable PubMed publication feed, with query rules reviewed for false matches.
Edited page copy, deployment, and practical update instructions.
packages.materials: Your current site or draft copy, people and project details, publication identifiers, and any existing visual assets.
packages.scope: Page count, content readiness, publication-query complexity, and migration needs determine the quote.
packages.example: This publication’s static website and searchable archive

packages.name: Research Visibility Package
packages.problem: A paper, talk, or project needs a useful explanation for people outside its immediate field.
deliverables: Plain-language research summaries and project descriptions.
A scoped set of lab-news, website, or short-form research updates.
Source-linked copy with qualifications intact and a reusable handoff.
packages.materials: The papers, slides, recordings, or draft copy; the intended audience; and where the material will appear.
packages.scope: The number of outputs, source volume, and depth of editorial work determine the quote.
packages.example: The Edge of Epidemiology essay collection

packages.name: Data / Stats / Writing Cleanup Sprint
packages.problem: An analysis, figure, codebase, or scientific draft needs to become understandable and reproducible.
deliverables: A defined R/Python analysis, code-cleanup, figure, or writing deliverable.
Checks of assumptions, units, denominators, and interpretation relevant to that deliverable.
A reproducible report or revised artifact with handoff notes.
packages.materials: A description of the research question, current code or draft, data documentation, and an appropriate shareable sample where needed.
packages.scope: Data condition, analysis complexity, and the size of the requested revision determine the quote.
packages.example: The timeline’s documented records and comparative evidence views

packages.name: Evidence Translation Sprint
packages.problem: A clinical, public-health, policy, or research question needs a bounded, source-backed answer.
deliverables: A defined question, search strategy, and inclusion boundaries.
An evidence table or annotated source packet distinguishing findings from interpretation.
A brief, memo, or slide-ready summary suited to the audience.
packages.materials: Your decision or question, audience, existing sources, and any constraints on the review.
packages.scope: Question breadth, literature volume, source access, and output format determine the quote.

packages.name: Research Exhibit or Topic Monitor
packages.problem: A disease, dataset, historical subject, or research program would benefit from an explorable public resource.
deliverables: A scoped map, timeline, exhibit, reference page, or monitoring interface.
Accessible record views, source links, and explicit evidence limitations.
A maintainable static build with documented data and update procedures.
packages.materials: The topic and intended audience, source material or dataset, desired interactions, and your update needs.
packages.scope: The number of views, data preparation, custom interactions, and update integration determine the quote.
packages.example: The Maritime Disease Atlas and Pathogen Dispatch
